name: kiln_near
purpose: One huge mesh seen from near and far at once (G3b, clusters): the kiln of kiln.json, with a camera a few centimetres off the dome, so that its near triangles are many pixels across while the far end of the same mesh is under a pixel a triangle; a grazing view along it; and one from far away. No Cycles truth: pictures are judged against the same scene at full detail. Local only (see kiln.json).
